maps.normal: surface bumps, OpenGL (+Y); load as linear data
maps.orh: R occlusion (shades hollows), G roughness (light is matte), B height (0-1, light is raised); linear data

formats.bc7: BC7 with Zstandard compression, for GPUs that support BC7, commonly desktops
formats.uastc: Basis Universal UASTC with Zstandard compression; the loader converts it to a format the GPU supports
